task.question: What is the largest single-day intraday range (high minus low) recorded for ticker 'SHREECEM'?

result.question: What is the largest single-day intraday range (high minus low) recorded for ticker 'SHREECEM'?
result.cited_sql: SELECT MAX(high - low) as max_range FROM prices p JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id WHERE i.ticker = 'SHREECEM'
